A customer realises his Top Gun bike dream and the Cog put on an ambitious event. Roy gives Richard a hard time over the slow progress on his Morgan.

How can steel repair itself? How do they create the world's most powerful bikes? And how is wood transformed into paper?
Find out how they make military helicopters, how they design metro systems and how they engineer artificial reefs.

Brand new series: Is this the end of Freddy and Beks? Will Inga come between Jazz and Eve? Will Zeyno go to the ball with Liam? And is Tristan thinking about starting a family?

Michon's: Can Gordon help the unwell owner of a family-run Atlanta smokehouse address his daughter's hands-off management style?
High-flying groom Kev sits down with his bride Trish to remember one of the most turbulent weddings in Don't Tell the Bride history. (Ep3)
Jonah's claims shake his family. Dee Dee sabotages her audition. And it's full steam ahead for one couple as they plan their wedding...

Charlie's: Gordon Ramsay visits Italian bistro Charlie's, where the pasta's soggy, the lasagne's a liability and the chef can't even cook a meatball.
Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments. A boy gets hold of a shaver and decides to give himself a quick trim...

It Had to Be You: Jazz asks Will to date his sister, Janet, who's just moved to town. But she turns out to be extremely bossy.
The Fabulous Faker Boy: Bart doesn't want to go to piano lessons, until he meets his beautiful teacher... Homer loses the last two hairs on his head.

Brawl in the Family: The Simpsons have a fight when a game of Monopoly goes wrong, and Maggie has to call the police.

Homerland: When Homer returns from a nuclear power convention a changed man, Lisa suspects that he might have been brainwashed and hires an FBI agent to investigate.
Treehouse of Horror XXIV: In three spine-tingling stories, Homer rhymes in a Dr Seuss-style tale, Bart is beheaded in a kite-flying prang, and a travelling circus visits town.

Brand new series - Panel: Ava and Gregory are invited to speak on a panel about public schools, while the other teachers complete CPR training.
Will Gets a Job: Will thinks that the Bel-Air lifestyle is making him lazy, and gets a job so that he can start paying his own way.
